title: Alantolactone inhibits cervical cancer progression by downregulating BMI1.
authors: Sun, Xiaodong; Xu, Hongxia; Dai, Tianyu; Xie, Lixia; Zhao, Qiang; Hao, Xincai; Sun, Yan; Wang, Xuanbin; Jiang, Nan; Sang, Ming
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Alantolactone通过下调BMI1抑制宫颈癌进展，仅用分子对接虚拟筛选药物-蛋白互作，核心是肿瘤生物学而非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制。
abstract: Cervical cancer is the second most common cancer in women. Despite advances in cervical cancer therapy, tumor recurrence and metastasis remain the leading causes of mortality. High expression of BMI1 is significantly associated with poor tumor differentiation, high clinical grade, and poor prognosis of cervical cancer, and is an independent prognostic factor in cervical carcinoma. Alantolactone (AL), a sesquiterpene lactone, exhibits potent anti-inflammatory and anticancer activities. In this paper, we investigated the mechanism of AL in reducing the proliferation, migration, and invasion of HeLa and SiHa cervical cancer cells as well as its promotion of mitochondrial damage and autophagy. BMI1 silencing decreased epithelial-mesenchymal transformation-associated proteins and increased autophagy-associated proteins in HeLa cells. These effects were reversed by overexpression of BMI1 in HeLa cells. Thus, BMI1 expression is positively correlated with invasion and negatively correlated with autophagy in HeLa cells. Importantly, AL decreased the weight, volume, and BMI1 expression in HeLa xenograft tumors. Furthermore, the structure of BMI1 and target interaction of AL were virtually screened using the molecular docking program Autodock Vina; AL decreased the expression of N-cadherin, vimentin, and P62 and increased the expression of LC3B and Beclin-1 in xenograft tumors. Finally, expression of BMI1 increased the phosphorylation of STAT3, which is important for cell proliferation, survival, migration, and invasion. Therefore, we suggest that AL plays a pivotal role in inhibiting BMI1 in the tumorigenesis of cervical cancer and is a potential therapeutic agent for cervical cancer.
abstract_zh: 宫颈癌是女性中第二常见的癌症。尽管宫颈癌治疗取得了进展，肿瘤复发和转移仍是导致死亡的主要原因。BMI1的高表达与宫颈癌的不良分化、高临床分级及不良预后显著相关，并且是宫颈癌的独立预后因素。土木香内酯（Alantolactone, AL），一种倍半萜内酯，展现出强效的抗炎和抗癌活性。本文研究了AL在降低HeLa和SiHa宫颈癌细胞增殖、迁移和侵袭以及促进线粒体损伤和自噬方面的机制。在HeLa细胞中，BMI1沉默降低了上皮-间质转化相关蛋白，并增加了自噬相关蛋白。这些效应在HeLa细胞中通过BMI1过表达被逆转。因此，在HeLa细胞中，BMI1表达与侵袭呈正相关，与自噬呈负相关。重要的是，AL降低了HeLa异种移植瘤的重量、体积和BMI1表达。此外，利用分子对接程序Autodock Vina对BMI1结构与AL的靶点相互作用进行了虚拟筛选；AL在异种移植瘤中降低了N-钙粘蛋白、波形蛋白和P62的表达，并增加了LC3B和Beclin-1的表达。最后，BMI1的表达增加了STAT3的磷酸化，这对细胞增殖、存活、迁移和侵袭至关重要。因此，我们建议AL在宫颈癌肿瘤发生中通过抑制BMI1发挥关键作用，并可能成为宫颈癌的潜在治疗药物。
